Managing AI requires new interfaces.

These are the physical things I have been trying out to control Code. Given how useful voice mode is, the Teenage Engineering Ting walky-talky has been a surprising favorite. The Codex Micro is beautiful & fun, but displays too little info vs the Stream Deck
